faq_heading: Ladner Elementary condos and townhomes: your questions answered

faq.q: What did condos and townhomes in Ladner Elementary sell for?
faq.a: 15 townhomes sold in Ladner Elementary between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $850,000.

faq.q: How long do condos and townhomes take to sell in Ladner Elementary?
faq.a: The median was 51 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.6% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most condos and townhomes in Ladner Elementary sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 15 townhomes that sold in Ladner Elementary went for between $762,500 and $943,750, around a median of $850,000.

faq.q: Do condos and townhomes in Ladner Elementary sell above asking price?
faq.a: 0% of the 15 townhomes sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 96.6% of it.

faq.q: What is a typical strata fee for condos and townhomes in Ladner Elementary?
faq.a: Of the 15 sales, 14 listings gave a monthly fee and the median was $430.

faq.q: How old are the condos and townhomes that sold in Ladner Elementary?
faq.a: The median year built was 2015 for the 15 townhomes sold in Ladner Elementary.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do condos and townhomes in Ladner Elementary usually have?
faq.a: The median townhome that sold in Ladner Elementary had 3 bedrooms, from the 15 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

blocks.text: Ladner Elementary condos and townhomes for sale now
What Ladner Elementary condos and townhomes sold for, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026

15 townhomes sold in Ladner Elementary with a median price of $850,000 (the middle half sold between $762,500 and $943,750), taking a median of 51 days to sell at 96.6% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $574 per square foot, a median year built of 2015 and a median strata fee of $430 a month. 7 condos sold in Ladner Elementary with a median price of $622,500, taking a median of 21 days to sell at 96.6% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $517 per square foot, a median year built of 1991 and a median strata fee of $517 a month.

blocks.text: How Ladner Elementary compares with the rest of Ladner

The median townhome in Ladner Elementary sold for $850,000, 4% below the Ladner median of $890,000 across 62 sales. Ladner Elementary townhomes took a median 51 days to sell, against 38 days for Ladner as a whole.
